Apa itu Automation?

Automation fokus pada membuat tugas lebih mudah dan lebih cepat untuk dilakukan manusia.

👤

Individual Customers

SaaS apps via browser
Google Docs, Office 365

🏢

Large Cloud Customers

Enterprise tools untuk
deploy & manage infrastruktur

🏗️

Cloud Providers

Sophisticated tools untuk
manage data center & requests

Tantangan Data Center

📏

Extreme Scale

Ribuan rack, perangkat, kabel power & data yang harus diinstall dan dikonfigurasi

🎯

Diverse Services

Berbagai layanan dengan requirement berbeda: compute, storage, network, security

🔄

Constant Change

Deployment baru, update software, scaling resources setiap hari secara kontinu

⚠️

Human Error

Kesalahan konfigurasi manual dapat menyebabkan downtime dan security breach

Apa Saja yang Bisa Di-Automate?

🖥️

Creation & Deployment

VMs, containers, virtual storage (SAN/NAS), virtual networks (VLANs, subnets)

📊

Monitoring & Accounting

Load measurement, resource tracking, hot spot identification, capacity prediction

⚡

Optimizations

VM placement, latency minimization, network traffic optimization, power usage

🛡️

Safety & Recovery

Backups, server monitoring, fast rerouting, RAID monitoring, auto restart

🔄

Software Updates

OS updates, software upgrades, continuous deployment, patch management

🔒

Security Policies

Firewall deployment, tenant data protection, secrets management, encryption

→
2

Full Auto
Level 1: Human does everything manually
Level 3: System suggests, human approves
Level 5: System decides and acts autonomously

Ringkasan Automation

Hampir semua operational tasks bisa di-automate.

  • Creation & deployment of virtual resources
  • Workload monitoring & accounting
  • Optimizations (placement, migration, power)
  • Safety & recovery mechanisms
  • Software update & upgrade
  • Administration of security policies

Providers memiliki multiple conflicting goals — automation membantu menyeimbangkannya.

Dari Automation ke Orchestration

Orchestration = Automation dengan scope yang lebih besar.
"Automation at scale"

🧱

Automation

Building blocks
Individual tasks
Scripts & playbooks

VS
🎻

Orchestration

The conductor
Coordinates all blocks
System-wide harmony

Automation vs Orchestration

FeatureAutomationOrchestration
TasksSingle, repetitiveSequence of tasks
DecisionMinimalComplex, policy-driven
ScaleTask-levelSystem / multi-environment
ToolsBash, Ansible, TerraformKubernetes, OpenShift
OversightInitial config onlyInitial setup, then autonomous
ScopeLocal — one aspectGlobal — all subsystems

Mengapa Orchestration Diperlukan?

📈

Rapid Creation

Manual automation tidak scalable. Aplikasi modern: ratusan/rbuan container & microservices.

⏱️

Short Lifetime

Container sering start, stop, migrate antar node. Orchestration menangani dependency & recovery.

🔄

Replication

Essential untuk large-scale. Memastikan startup order & service dependencies (DB sebelum API).

🛡️

Self-Healing

Health checks otomatis, restart failed containers, load balancing tanpa intervensi manusia.

Kubernetes (K8s) Overview

Open-source container orchestration system
Originally by Google → CNCF

📦

Auto Deploy

Declarative deployment
Desired state management

📈

Auto Scale

Horizontal scaling
Load balancing

🛡️

Auto Heal

Fault recovery
Self-healing containers

Kubernetes abstracts underlying infrastructure — users define desired state, K8s ensures it.

Limitations Kubernetes

Kubernetes TIDAK:

  • Focus pada specific application type
  • Manage source code atau build containers
  • Supply event-passing middleware
  • Handle monitoring atau event logging
  • Manage non-containerized workloads
🧩

Layered Ecosystem

Orchestration adalah ecosystem berlapis, bukan single tool. Network orchestration & storage management memerlukan sistem terpisah.

Kubernetes Cluster Model

Control Plane

Management & coordination

Worker Nodes

Execution of containers

Control Plane Components

🌐

API Server

Central switchboard. Semua komunikasi internal & external melalui API server. REST interface untuk kubectl.

💾

etcd

Distributed key-value store. Menyimpan cluster state, config, dan metadata. "Source of truth" cluster.

📅

Scheduler

Menentukan worker node mana untuk menjalankan pod baru berdasarkan resources & constraints.

🎮

Controller Manager

Menjalankan controller processes: Node, Replication, Endpoints, Service Account & Token controllers.

Worker Node Components

👷

Kubelet

Agent di setiap node. Berkomunikasi dengan Master via API server. Menerima instruksi & mengirim pod status.

🔌

Service Proxy

Mengkonfigurasi iptables untuk intra-node & inter-node communication. Pods access services transparently.

📊

cAdvisor

Embedded dalam Kubelet. Mengumpulkan container-level metrics: CPU, memory, network, disk usage.

🐳

Container Runtime

Menjalankan container operations: dockerd, containerd, CRI-O. Foundation semua pod-level execution.

Pods: Unit Terkecil

Pod = smallest deployable unit di Kubernetes.
Bisa berisi satu atau lebih container yang share storage, network, dan config.

🎯

Single-Container Pod

Most common. Satu container per pod = satu instance aplikasi.

🔗

Multi-Container Pod

Tightly coupled containers. Share IP address & storage volumes. Sidecar pattern.

🚀

Init Containers

Berjalan SEBELUM main containers. Untuk setup, check dependencies, initialize data.

📍

IP Address

Setiap pod mendapat IP unik. Multi-container pod = satu IP untuk semua container.

Kubernetes Key Features

FeatureDeskripsiBenefit
ReplicasKontrol jumlah pod copiesScalability & load management
DeploymentsAutomated scaling dengan intent-based modelMaintains desired replicas
StatefulSetsManage stateful apps dengan persistent identityPredictable naming & persistence
DaemonSetsRun pod di setiap nodeNode-level logging/monitoring
JobsRun pods sampai completionReliable task completion
CronJobsSchedule jobs periodicallyAutomated recurring tasks
ServicesStable access policy & load balancingConsistent access, decoupled

Hands-On Lab 1: Ansible

Goal: Automate Nginx web server deployment di Ubuntu
dengan konten dinamis (hostname & IP address)

Control Node

cloud
192.168.56.105
Runs Ansible

Managed Node

cloudclone
192.168.56.106
Target Nginx server

Lab Ansible: Setup & SSH

# 1. Install Ansible
sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y ansible
ansible --version

# 2. Generate SSH Key
ssh-keygen -t rsa -b 4096 -f ~/.ssh/id_rsa_ansible -N ""

# 3. Copy key ke target
ssh-copy-id -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa_ansible.pub cloud@192.168.56.106

# 4. Test SSH tanpa password
ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa_ansible cloud@192.168.56.106

Step 1: Install

Ansible adalah agentless — tidak perlu install agent di target node.

Step 2-3: SSH Key

Key-based auth memungkinkan Ansible connect tanpa password prompt.

Step 4: Verify

Pastikan SSH berfungsi sebelum lanjut ke playbook.

Lab Ansible: Inventory & Test

# Buat struktur project
mkdir -p ~/ansible-project && cd ~/ansible-project

# Buat inventory file
cat > inventory << 'EOF'
[webservers]
192.168.56.105 ansible_user=cloud ansible_ssh_private_key_file=~/.ssh/id_rsa_ansible
192.168.56.106 ansible_user=cloud ansible_ssh_private_key_file=~/.ssh/id_rsa_ansible
EOF

# Test konektivitas
ansible -i ./inventory webservers -m ping

# Expected: SUCCESS => {"ping": "pong"}

Struktur Project

inventory, site.yml, index.html.j2

Inventory

Definisikan grup [webservers] dengan IP, user, dan path ke private key.

Ping Test

Module ping bukan ICMP ping, tapi test Ansible connectivity.

Lab Ansible: Playbook

---
- name: Deploy nginx and web page
  hosts: webservers
  become: yes
  gather_facts: yes

  tasks:
    - name: Update apt cache
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        update_cache: yes

    - name: Ensure nginx is installed
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name: nginx
        state: present

    - name: Deploy index.html from template
      ansible.builtin.template:
        src: index.html.j2
        dest: /var/www/html/index.html

    - name: Ensure nginx is started
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: nginx
        state: started
        enabled: yes
become: yes = sudo gather_facts = hostname, IP idempotent = safe re-run

Lab Ansible: Jinja2 Template

cat > index.html.j2 << 'EOF'
<html>
<head><title>Deployed by Ansible</title></head>
<body>
  <h1>Hello from {{ ansible_hostname }}!</h1>
  <p>IP: {{ ansible_default_ipv4.address }}</p>
  <p>Deployed: {{ ansible_date_time.date }}</p>
</body></html>
EOF

# Jalankan playbook
ansible-playbook -i ./inventory site.yml

# Verify
curl http://192.168.56.106

Jinja2 Variables

ansible_hostname → nama host
ansible_default_ipv4.address → IP
ansible_date_time.date → tanggal

Template Module

Render template dengan facts yang dikumpulkan dari tiap target node.

Expected Result

Halaman menampilkan hostname & IP yang berbeda per node!

Hands-On Lab 2: Kubernetes

Goal: Memahami Pod, Deployment, Service,
scaling, self-healing, dan rolling update

minikube

Local K8s cluster

kubectl

CLI untuk K8s

Docker

Container runtime

Lab K8s: Start Cluster & Pod

# Start minikube
minikube start --driver=docker
kubectl get nodes

# Buat Pod manifest
cat > pod-nginx.yml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: nginx-pod
  labels:
    app: web
spec:
  containers:
  - name: nginx
    image: nginx:latest
    ports:
    - containerPort: 80
EOF

# Deploy & cek
kubectl apply -f pod-nginx.yml
kubectl get pods -o wide

minikube

Single-node K8s cluster untuk development & learning.

Manifest YAML

apiVersion, kind, metadata, spec = 4 field wajib setiap K8s object.

Labels

Key-value pairs untuk identify & select objects. Fundamental untuk Service & Deployment.

Lab K8s: Deployment & Scale

# Deployment dengan 3 replicas
cat > deployment-nginx.yml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: nginx-deployment
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: nginx
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: nginx
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.25
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
EOF

kubectl apply -f deployment-nginx.yml
kubectl get pods
kubectl scale deployment nginx-deployment --replicas=5

Deployment vs Pod

Deployment mengelola ReplicaSet yang mengelola Pods. Pod mati? Auto recreate!

Selector

matchLabels menghubungkan Deployment dengan Pods yang dikelolanya.

Scale

Dari 3 ke 5 replicas dalam satu command. Load balancer otomatis distribute traffic.

Lab K8s: Service & Access

# Expose Deployment via Service
cat > service-nginx.yml << 'EOF'
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: nginx-service
spec:
  selector:
    app: nginx
  ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 80
      targetPort: 80
  type: NodePort
EOF

kubectl apply -f service-nginx.yml
kubectl get service nginx-service
minikube service nginx-service --url

Service Abstraction

Service memberikan stable IP & DNS untuk grup Pods yang dinamis.

Selector Matching

selector: app: nginx → route traffic ke semua Pod dengan label tersebut.

NodePort

Expose service di port 30000-32767 setiap node. Akses dari luar cluster.

Lab K8s: Self-Healing Demo

# Lihat pods yang running
kubectl get pods
NAME                    READY   STATUS
nginx-deployment-xxx    1/1     Running
nginx-deployment-yyy    1/1     Running
nginx-deployment-zzz    1/1     Running

# Hapus satu pod (simulasi failure)
kubectl delete pod nginx-deployment-xxx

# Amati magic happens!
kubectl get pods -w
nginx-deployment-xxx    1/1     Terminating
nginx-deployment-www    0/1     Pending
nginx-deployment-www    1/1     Running

# Tekan Ctrl+C untuk stop watch

Desired State

Deployment mendefinisikan replicas: 3. Ini adalah desired state.

Controller Loop

Controller Manager terus membandingkan actual state vs desired state.

Self-Healing

Pod dihapus → actual state = 2. Controller otomatis buat pod baru → kembali ke 3.

Lab K8s: Rolling Update

# Update image ke versi baru
kubectl set image deployment/nginx-deployment nginx=nginx:1.26

# Monitor rolling update
kubectl rollout status deployment/nginx-deployment

# Cek history
kubectl rollout history deployment/nginx-deployment

# Rollback jika ada masalah
kubectl rollout undo deployment/nginx-deployment

# Cleanup
kubectl delete all --all
minikube stop

Rolling Update

Update gradual: pod lama di-terminate, pod baru di-create. Zero downtime!

History

Setiap revision tersimpan. Bisa rollback ke versi sebelumnya kapan saja.

Undo

kubectl rollout undo → kembalikan ke revision sebelumnya secara otomatis.
